words.definition: unwanted or useless items or material
words.example: Please clear out the junk in the storage closet this weekend.
words.exampleTranslation: 這週末請清理儲物間裡的雜物。

words.definition: a polite way to address a woman, especially one you don't know
words.example: The receptionist greeted her with 'Good morning, ma'am.'
words.exampleTranslation: 接待人員向她問候：「早安，女士。」

words.definition: the distance traveled, measured in miles, or the amount of use gotten from something
words.example: Employees can claim mileage for business trips using their own car.
words.exampleTranslation: 員工開自己的車出差可以申請里程補助。

words.definition: making or full of a lot of loud sound
words.example: The construction next door has made the office quite noisy.
words.exampleTranslation: 隔壁的施工讓辦公室變得相當吵鬧。

words.definition: a flat-bottomed container used for cooking food
words.example: The test kitchen ordered a new set of pans for the cooking demo.
words.exampleTranslation: 試驗廚房為了烹飪示範訂購了一組新的平底鍋。

words.definition: an item or items wrapped up for mailing or carrying; a package
words.example: A parcel arrived for you at the front desk this morning.
words.exampleTranslation: 今天早上有一個包裹送到前台，是給你的。

words.definition: an Italian food made from dough, shaped into various forms
words.example: The cafeteria added a pasta bar to the weekly menu.
words.exampleTranslation: 自助餐廳在每週菜單裡新增了一個義大利麵吧。

words.definition: a magazine or journal published at regular intervals
words.example: The library subscribes to several business periodicals.
words.exampleTranslation: 圖書館訂閱了好幾份商業期刊。

words.definition: a small tablet of medicine taken by swallowing
words.example: The clinic reminded staff to take their allergy pills before the outdoor event.
words.exampleTranslation: 診所提醒員工在戶外活動前先服用過敏藥丸。

words.definition: able to be easily carried or moved
words.example: Each technician was issued a portable scanner for inventory checks.
words.exampleTranslation: 每位技術人員都配發了一台便攜式掃描器用於盤點。

words.definition: arriving or doing something at the agreed or expected time
words.example: Being punctual for client meetings is part of our company culture.
words.exampleTranslation: 準時參加客戶會議是我們公司文化的一部分。

words.definition: activities done for enjoyment when not working
words.example: The resort offers a wide range of recreation for guests.
words.exampleTranslation: 這間度假村為房客提供多樣的休閒活動。

words.definition: to make pain, distress, or a burden less severe
words.example: The new hire will relieve some of the workload from the current team.
words.exampleTranslation: 這位新進員工將能減輕現有團隊的部分工作負擔。

words.definition: something that helps a person remember an event or task
words.example: You'll receive an email reminder a day before the appointment.
words.exampleTranslation: 你會在約診前一天收到電子郵件提醒。

words.definition: information or a story spread among people without confirmation of its truth
words.example: Management addressed the rumor about upcoming layoffs directly.
words.exampleTranslation: 管理層直接回應了關於即將裁員的傳聞。

words.definition: a piece of fabric worn around the neck or head
words.example: The uniform includes a branded scarf for winter.
words.exampleTranslation: 冬季制服包含一條印有品牌標誌的圍巾。

words.definition: an area located next to the sea
words.example: This year's retreat will be held at a seaside resort.
words.exampleTranslation: 今年的員工靜修活動將在海邊度假村舉行。

words.definition: to make something shorter in length or duration
words.example: We shortened the meeting to make time for the site visit.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們縮短了會議時間，好留時間進行現場參訪。

words.definition: for a particular purpose; especially
words.example: The gift box was specially designed for the holiday season.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個禮盒是專門為節日季節設計的。

words.definition: to cause liquid to flow out of a container accidentally
words.example: Someone spilled coffee near the server room, so it had to be cleaned up quickly.
words.exampleTranslation: 有人在伺服器機房附近打翻了咖啡，必須馬上清理。
